lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\TwoFactorWebauthn\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
The Composer autoloader is optimized beyond level 1. The manual allows only config.optimize-autoloader: an authoritative class map breaks the upgrade of the app, and APCu is no required extension.

1 boolean column is NotNull. Oracle cannot store false in such a column, so the server stops the migration with an exception. A boolean column needs notnull false.
Up to Nextcloud 32 the server checks this only where info.xml lists no database, or lists oci among them. From Nextcloud 33 on the server makes the column nullable on Oracle itself.

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.
